name: 流星腰带

code: function executeSkill(context){var c=context.piece,turn=Number(battle.turn.turnNumber),statusId='el-primo-meteor-belt-'+c.instanceId+'-'+turn;addStatusEffectById(c.instanceId,{id:statusId,type:'el-primo-meteor-belt',name:'流星腰带',visible:true,stacking:'none',currentDuration:2,remainingDuration:2,stacks:1,relatedRules:['rule-el-primo-meteor-belt']});addRuleById(c.instanceId,'rule-el-primo-meteor-belt');return{success:true,message:c.name+'获得流星腰带，持续2回合'};}
